description: React component for displaying user activity logs with session details, device info, and revoke session functionality.

classes.name: ActivityLog
classes.description: React component class for rendering activity log entries, including device info, last activity time, and session revocation.

methods.name: handleMoreInfo
methods.description: Sets state to show more info about the session.

methods.name: submitRevoke
methods.description: Calls the submitRevoke prop to revoke the current session.

methods.name: isMobileSession
methods.description: Determines if the session is from a mobile device based on device_id.

methods.name: sessionInfo
methods.description: Generates device icon, title, and platform info based on session properties.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the activity log entry with device icon, last activity time, and revoke button.
